description.narrative: Pomona will support value creation for its portfolio in Central America and commit to investing in at least 30 percent female led portfolio companies for the first time. The market creation claim is to support the creation and development of nascent PE markets via demonstration effects. PE markets in Central America are highly underdeveloped, with only a small amount of activity in a few large countries.

The proposed transaction is an equity investment of up to US$7.5 million and up to 25% of the funds total commitments in Pomona Impact Fund II, LP (Pomona II or the Fund) a SMEV fund targeting US$30 million in commitments to invest in small enterprises in Central America, with opportunistic investments in Mexico, Colombia, and Ecuador. The Fund will seek to make approximately 15 investments in SMEs including some pre-profit tech-focused SMEs, providing ticket sizes between US$0.5 million and US$2.0 million. Pomona II will focus primarily on Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras (IDA) and Nicaragua (IDA), with a secondary focus on Belize, Costa Rica and Panama. Up to 20% of the Fund may be allocated in opportunistic investments in Mexico, Colombia and Ecuador. The Fund is sector agnostic but will focus on industries where Pomona has developed expertise and has the most potential social impact, such as: Agriculture, Education, Health and Water.
